summary_en: Manage co-owned buildings — budgets, assemblies, calls for funds, works.
summary_fr: Gérer l'immeuble en copropriété — budgets, AG, appels de fonds, travaux.

tools.name: Buildium
tools.positioning: The property management system a small management company can actually implement without a project team.
tools.description: Buildium covers residential rentals, community associations and affordable housing: listings, applications and screening, leases, rent collection, maintenance, accounting and owner reporting, with published per-unit pricing and self-serve onboarding. Now part of RealPage.
tools.real_estate_use: It sits at the tier below AppFolio and Entrata: a company managing a few hundred doors, often mixed between rentals and homeowner associations. The HOA module handles association dues, violations and architectural requests, which is why small managers with both books of business consolidate here rather than run two systems.
features: Listings, applications and tenant screening
Lease management with e-signature and renewals
Online rent and association dues collection
Maintenance requests, work orders and vendor payments
Property, owner and association accounting with 1099s
Resident, owner and board member portals

use_cases.job: Manage a few hundred rental doors without a dedicated systems administrator
Run homeowner association dues, violations and board reporting in the same tool as rentals

tools.name: Crypto (Septeo Solutions Immobilier)
tools.positioning: The incumbent French property administration suite — installed across a large share of professional syndic and gérance portfolios.
tools.description: Crypto, part of Septeo's real estate division, covers syndic, gérance and transaction for French property administrators: per-building and mandant accounting, calls for funds, assemblies, lease and receipt management, and extranets for co-owners, owners and tenants.
tools.real_estate_use: It is the system of record in many established French administration de biens firms, chosen for accounting depth rather than for interface. Its centre of gravity is the regulated ledger: separate accounts per copropriété, mandant funds kept distinct from the firm's own money, and the reporting a comptable and an auditor expect.
features: Syndic accounting per building with regulatory account structures
Gérance with mandant accounting and owner reddition de comptes
Calls for funds, budgets and assembly management
Lease, receipt and indexation handling
Co-owner, owner and tenant extranets
Transaction module and document management

use_cases.job: Keep regulated per-building accounts that satisfy an auditor
Produce owner reddition de comptes from mandant accounting rather than a spreadsheet

tools.name: Gercop
tools.positioning: Property administration software for larger French firms, where volume and multi-site organisation are the constraint.
tools.description: Gercop, also part of Septeo, provides syndic, gérance and transaction management for French administration de biens: accounting, assemblies, calls for funds, lease management, extranets and business reporting, aimed at structures managing large portfolios.
tools.real_estate_use: At the scale of tens of thousands of lots across multiple branches, the operational problem moves from bookkeeping to organisation: who manages which building, which assemblies fall in which month, where arrears are concentrating. Gercop is bought for that management layer over the same regulated accounting base.
features: Syndic and gérance accounting at portfolio scale
Assembly planning and convocation across many buildings
Calls for funds, arrears tracking and recovery workflows
Lease management with indexation and charge regularisation
Multi-branch organisation and portfolio assignment
Management reporting and dashboards

use_cases.job: Plan and run assemblies across hundreds of buildings without losing deadlines
Track arrears concentration across a large managed portfolio

tools.name: ICS
tools.positioning: Independent French software suite for property administrators, used daily by more than 18,000 professionals across cloud-based syndic, management, rental and transaction modules.
tools.description: ICS is a French software suite built for administrateurs de biens, covering condominium syndic management, property management, rental management and sales transactions. It is delivered as cloud applications accessible from a standard web browser, with servers hosted in a Class IV datacenter.
tools.real_estate_use: Property management firms and syndics in France use ICS to run their daily back office: co-ownership accounting, fund calls and general assembly administration through the syndic module, rental portfolio tracking through the gestion and location modules, and sales file follow-up through the transaction module. Because it runs in the cloud, staff access the same accounting and extra-accounting environment from any browser without maintaining local servers or a VPN.
features: Cloud-based access to accounting and extra-accounting environment via web browser
Syndic module for condominium accounting and general assembly management
Gestion module for property management portfolios
Location module for rental management
Transaction module for sales transaction tracking
Hosting in a Class IV datacenter with audited backup strategy

use_cases.job: Manage condominium accounting, fund calls and general assemblies from a cloud application
Administer rental and managed property portfolios without on-premise IT infrastructure
Track sales transactions within the same software suite used for management and syndic activity

tools.name: LockImmo
tools.positioning: One French system for the three trades an agency can hold at once — transaction, gérance and syndic.
tools.description: LockImmo is a modular French real estate platform covering transaction, rental management and condominium management, with accounting, owner and co-owner portals, electronic signature and portal publishing, sold module by module.
tools.real_estate_use: A French agency frequently holds all three activities under one roof, and the accounting requirements differ for each: mandant accounting for gérance, separate accounts per copropriété for syndic. LockImmo covers the three in one system, which small and mid-sized agencies choose over running three specialised tools with no shared client record.
features: Transaction module with mandates and matching
Rental management with mandant accounting and owner statements
Condominium module with per-building accounting and calls for funds
Owner, tenant and co-owner extranet portals
Electronic signature and document management
Portal publishing and agency website

use_cases.job: Hold transaction, gérance and syndic in one system with shared client records
Run per-building accounting and calls for funds alongside rental management

tools.name: Matera
tools.positioning: Digital platform that lets condominium councils run their own cooperative syndic while a team of in-house experts handles the technical, legal and accounting complexity.
tools.description: Matera is a SaaS platform for French condominiums choosing the cooperative-syndic model, where the council of co-owners manages the building itself instead of hiring a professional syndic firm. The platform centralizes real-time accounting, budget tracking, service-charge calls, document storage, an online messaging system and general-assembly organization (including video conferencing and online voting), and gives access to Matera's in-house teams of accountants, lawyers and building-works specialists for complex matters. Matera also offers a separate rental-management product for landlords who self-manage tenanted properties.
tools.real_estate_use: A council of co-owners who wants to drop a traditional syndic firm and take direct control of the building's finances and decisions logs into Matera to track the budget, issue and follow up on service charges, and organize the annual general assembly online. When an incident occurs, such as a water leak, any council member can open a work order, contact a vetted local tradesperson from Matera's network, and follow the repair through to closure on the same platform. When a legal, accounting or technical question goes beyond what the council can resolve alone, they escalate it to Matera's in-house experts rather than hiring outside consultants.
features: Real-time per-building accounting dashboard
Automated service-charge calls and payment reminders
Online general-assembly organization with video conferencing and voting
Dedicated messaging space for council and co-owners
Document repository (minutes, contracts, invoices)
Work-order tracking for incidents and repairs

use_cases.job: Manage the condominium's budget, accounting and service-charge billing without a professional syndic firm
Organize and run the general assembly online, including votes and minutes distribution
Track incidents and repair work orders through resolution using a vetted tradesperson network

tools.name: Powimo
tools.positioning: Full-web property and condominium management software built to raise the productivity of property management firms.
tools.description: Powimo is a SaaS software for property administrators (ADB) covering both syndic (condominium) and rental management activities. It is organized into modules covering mandates, accounting, general assemblies, tenant/owner extranet, move-in/move-out inspections, maintenance requests, and letting.
tools.real_estate_use: A syndic manager uses Powimo to track co-ownership mandates, run accounting per building, prepare and hold dematerialized general assemblies, and issue fund calls to co-owners. A rental manager in the same firm uses it to manage lettings, tenant applications, and inspection reports, while owners and tenants follow their files through a dedicated client portal.
features: Syndic mandate tracking and entry
Per-building accounting and account consultation
General assembly management (including dematerialized AGs)
Supplier compliance checks
Data hub with business indicators
Document dematerialization and automation

use_cases.job: Manage co-ownership mandates, budgets, fund calls and general assemblies
Handle rental management, letting and tenant applications
Consult accounting and documents through a dedicated client portal

tools.name: Syment
tools.positioning: Condominium software designed for collaboration with the conseil syndical, including the volunteer syndic case.
tools.description: Syment is a French SaaS platform for condominium management covering accounting, budgets, calls for funds, assemblies with electronic voting, works tracking and a co-owner extranet, used both by professional syndics and by buildings managed by a volunteer co-owner.
tools.real_estate_use: A significant share of small French buildings are managed by a syndic bénévole — a co-owner who is not an accountant. That case has particular requirements: the accounting must be correct without accounting training, and the council must be able to see everything. Syment targets that gap while remaining usable by professionals on small portfolios.
features: Condominium accounting with tantième allocation
Budgets, calls for funds and arrears tracking
General assembly preparation with electronic voting
Co-owner and council extranet with document access
Works, quote and contract tracking
Guided workflows for non-professional syndics

use_cases.job: Run a small building's accounts and assembly without accounting training
Give the conseil syndical live visibility on the building's accounts

tools.name: Vilogi
tools.positioning: Condominium management software built for the French 1965 law, from the annual assembly to the works fund.
tools.description: Vilogi is a SaaS platform for French syndics and rental managers: per-building accounting, budgets and calls for funds, general assembly preparation and electronic voting, works and contract tracking, and extranet portals for co-owners and council members.
tools.real_estate_use: A French copropriété is a legal entity with its own accounts, its own budget voted in assembly, and a mandatory extranet for co-owners. Vilogi encodes that cycle: the provisional budget is voted, quarterly calls for funds are issued against it, expenses are posted per building, and the annual accounts are presented back to the assembly. The extranet obligation is met by the same system.
features: Per-building accounting with tantième-based expense allocation
Provisional budgets and quarterly calls for funds
General assembly preparation, convocation and electronic voting
Mandatory co-owner extranet with document access
Works, contract and insurance claim tracking
Rental management module for mixed portfolios

use_cases.job: Run the full annual cycle from voted budget to accounts presented at assembly
Meet the legal co-owner extranet obligation without a separate portal
